content: Customer Dhruv Kapoor inquired about the claim procedure and required documents for a COVID-19-related trip cancellation under his travel insurance policy (TRV-DC-2026-10). Insurance agent Neha Kapoor confirmed the policy's coverage, provided step-by-step instructions for submitting the claim via the secure portal or email along with the necessary documentation, and stated that the processing time takes 5-7 business days.

action_items: Complete the attached Travel Claim Form
Attach cancellation notice and supporting medical/quarantine documents
Submit completed form via portal or reply email
